text: Nde Annabi Ayyuuba tikkannoo debbo makko on, o woondiri piyugol mo loyru teemedere. Men wi'ani mo ontuma : Ko an Ayyuuba, nanngiri sookewo maa ngon, tamannde huɗo, piyiraa mo ɗum, no hunniraa woodoore maa nden, hara a firtaa nden. O waɗi ɗum. Men tawu mo, ko o muññiiɗo e ko Men jarribori mo kon. O moƴƴii jeyaaɗo. Pellet, ko o ɗuuɗunooɗo tuubugol ruttoo ka Allah.
